newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National down after negative comment.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National down after negative comment.

text.p: Shares in banking group Abbey National Plc dropped in early trading on Monday after negative press comment following the stock's recent strong gains, traders said.
Abbey shares, which set a record 812p on January 15, up some 28 percent since the start of November, were down 6-1/2p at 755-1/2 by 0815 GMT.
The Financial Times Lex column said Abbey shares were "hardly cheap" after their sharp rally and that business would likely get tougher.
Last week Goldman Sachs cut Abbey to "market underperformer" from "market performer" and earlier this month both Credit Lyonnais Laing and Lehman Brothers also lowered their rating on the stock.
